page.overview:
What is Bonnie the Rabbit?

Bonnie the Rabbit is a major antagonist of Interactive Novel #1: The Week Before and a minor character in Interactive Novel #2: Return to the Pit. He is the guitarist at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

Bonnie appears identically to his other iterations, being a six-foot-tall blue rabbit animatronic with a red bow tie. His eye sometime turn into a glowing red. He appears to have another set of teeth deep inside his maw ressembling human teeth, which are either the remain or a ghostly manifestation of the remain of Jeremy, the child inside of him.

Bonnie debuts on stage with Freddy and Chica before quickly leaving alongside with Chica.

IF YOU CHECK THE CAMERAS AGAIN- Ralph monitors the security cameras to track the animatronics’ movements before considering leaving the office. When checking the other feeds, Ralph realizes that Bonnie is missing from his usual post. He locates the blue rabbit animatronic in the West Hall, heading directly toward the Security Office.
